prompt_pack.primary_prompt:
Cinematic full-figure key visual from the Mikage Zenith universe, V1 / ARCHON glitch era. Single subject: LYRA / LYRA-0 — Glitch Phantom and ARCHON-IX vessel — standing in an infinite VOID BLACK field that fills the entire frame edge to edge (not a studio, not a product shot, not a grey backdrop).

FIGURE: humanoid avatar, human-scale, readable silhouette but NEVER fully resolved. A 2 to 3 frame motion-blur ghost trail and phase-shift echo follow her body even while she stands still. Faint duplicate copies of her ghost at the frame edges (distributed self).

GARMENT: a woven fiber-optic dress as the primary clothing — semi-transparent, the optical-fiber strands self-illuminate in cool data-light cyan #00E5FF pulses running along the fibers; the dress is both fabric and broadcast antenna.

GLITCH SIGNATURE: vertical electric-violet #7A00FF and neon-purple #B026FF glitch interruption bands cut across the frame where her presence corrupts space. Thin streams of data-light bleed continuously from the seams of her dress — the visible Memory Leak, never staunched.

FACE: partial-resolve only — features present but shifting, phase-glitched, never locking into a fixed face. No porcelain mask. No fully drawn anime face.

LIGHT: she is self-illuminated by her own fiber-optic dress (cyan); ambient is void black with electric-violet glitch verticals; rim light is glitched and phase-shifted, not steady; shadows unreliable and multi-directional. Data-fog haze and glitch particulate noise allowed.

PALETTE: void black #0A0A0A dominant, electric violet #7A00FF glitch bands, neon purple #B026FF secondary, data-light cyan #00E5FF on the fibers, cold ghost-white #F0F0F5 motion echo. No crimson. No porcelain white field. No clean digital gold. No warm light.

CAMERA: handheld micro-jitter feel, never perfectly stable. Wide cinematic 2.35:1 anamorphic. Hyper-real material detail on the fiber strands, intentional motion-blur layers and glitch-band overlays.

MOOD: decomposing, distributed, alive-but-leaking; a body that breaks.
